author: GamingBolt
description:
On the surface, Dead or Alive 6 Last Round looks like a complete version of the original release, but is that truly the case? We dove into it headfirst and had a few thoughts. Its fighting systems are great and definitely rewarding when you take the time to master them. 

You’ve got enough options to showcase that mastery, and the results will always make you feel satisfied. But there definitely are problems that hold it back from being a day-one purchase. If you’re on the fence about this one, our review is here to help you out. Join us as we take a good look at what works, and what doesn’t in this one, and help you decide if it’s worth your time.
title: Dead or Alive 6 Last Round Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
College Football 27 is just a little over two weeks away as we write this, and EA’s seemingly gone all out in its effort to make the third year of the franchise’s revival feel like an evolution instead of yet another pit stop in a series of incremental improvements. And while the rest of the experience is bringing a lot of exciting things to the table, we can’t help but look forward to the new and improved Dynasty Mode with eager anticipation.

There are a lot of reasons why, and we’re happy to tell you all about why we think the program-management side of things could become the star of the show this time around. Join us as we take you through our thoughts on the new things EA is bringing to the table, and why you should be as excited as we are about them.
title: EA Sports College Football 27’s Dynasty Mode Might Finally Be the True Main Event

author: GamingBolt
description:
A single Amazon listing sent us down a rabbit hole of possibilities regarding what NPC AI could bring to Leonida, the stage upon which GTA 6 aims to immerse us in a world where crime, intrigue, and daily activities collide with spectacle, and substance. 

We’re beginning to think that Lucia and Jason could be the franchise’s version of Alice, with Leonida being a wonderland where things are structured so they find you, instead of the other way around. 

Wondering what we’re on about? Join us as we explore possibilities Rockstar might be cooking up for us, and how that could change how the rest of the gaming world thinks about open-world games ahead of a new generation of hardware and experiences looming large on the horizon.
title: GTA 6's Biggest Gameplay Feature Could CHANGE Everything
